This is NOT the §8 typing question the other fifteen raise -- it is a FLOW question, and it is the second-largest award in the state.
options: (a) leave both rows PASS-THROUGH-UNRESOLVED in effect, as built: §8's standing fallback, NON_HOSPITAL, No, flagged FLOW_UNRESOLVED_HOSPITAL_AFFILIATED, in NEITHER bucket of rhtp_hospital_dollar_partition(); (b) PASS_THROUGH_DESIGNATED + Yes with intermediary_name = ARHP, IF a source shows the funds administered to or on behalf of member hospitals (§10.2's positive test, ICAHN's and OHA's wording); (c) IN_KIND_BENEFIT + No + hospital_benefiting = Yes, IF the source shows ARHP keeping the money and delivering goods or services -- the Georgia Hospital Association obstetrical-carts negative and the Alaska AHHA assessments negative.
why_it_is_open: ARHP is a consortium of rural Arkansas hospitals ON THIS PIPELINE'S OWN KNOWLEDGE. THE AWARD LIST SAYS NOTHING ABOUT IT AT ALL -- no form, no description -- so §8's name rule reaches nothing and §10.2's money-movement test has no sentence to read. The Governor's release describes its five projects (emergency generators; tele-consultation and EMS tele-triage; chronic care technology; behavioural health access; specialty care on command) and those descriptions are what §10.2 would read -- but they describe where a SERVICE lands, not where a DOLLAR goes, which is exactly the distinction session 31 built RHTP_MONEY_TO_HOSPITALS_MARKERS to preserve and exactly the distinction the spec's own two worked negatives turn on. The classifier reads those descriptions as IN_KIND_BENEFIT on all five, which is option (c) reached by machine; it is recorded in ar_year1_projects.csv and DELIBERATELY NOT adopted, because a hospital consortium is the one recipient class where 'the service reaches hospitals' and 'the money reaches hospitals' are hardest to tell apart from a project blurb.
dollar_effect: $18,833,521.00 -- 12.6% of everything Arkansas has awarded. Option (a) as built puts it in NEITHER bucket; (b) makes it a POOL_NAMED_HOSPITALS or POOL_UNNAMED_HOSPITALS pass-through dollar depending on whether a source names the member hospitals; (c) keeps it out of the hospital total while recording hospital_benefiting = Yes. It is counted in the AR_RECIPIENT_FORM_NOT_STATED ceiling above and must not be added twice.
